release_rule: Full collection must complete normally and its worker/controller be dead before any case loss, snapshot, tokens or measured labels are read; genuine failure must first be diagnosed and preserved. No partial-outcome decisions.
measurement: Four separate prompts, 32 completion patterns each, equal per-document mean completion CE including EOS. All before/after losses retained. Greatest centered improvement, no-change only when span<.02. Weak, tied and unexpected examples retained.
input_rules: No source-pattern label, batch examples or measured profile in interpreter inputs. Training learns only training labels. Development chooses saved epochs; reserved cases are never collected by this worker.
audits: one fresh AdamW step per actual case
zero B and unchanged A under no weight decay
bit-exact adapter and first-probe CE restoration
training_recipe_reference: results/update-loracle-program/protocol.json; training phase receives a separate complete frozen plan and training-only GPU preflight before training starts
inspection: Report all training/development label distributions, source-versus-effect mismatch, margins, spans and norms; never discard hard examples to manufacture a result.
